WaterColor!

7 min bike/20 min walk to WaterColor Beach Club, private beach access!

5 min walk to Camp WaterColor pool, Frog pool, lazy river, snack bar

3 min bike/14 min walk to Boathouse/Western Lake: paddleboard rentals and fishing!

6 miles to the Ed Walline Beach Access

Explore Seaside, WaterColor, Seagrove

4 bikes!

Outdoor deck, patio w/Green Egg grill

4-star restaurants

Cute boutiques

Relaxation Station 30A by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to a 3-bedroom beach getaway, tucked away in a beautiful, secluded section of WaterColor. WaterColor is a premier neighborhood, with a wonderful beach club, three-tiered pools, a restaurant, and a bar along with shopping and other food options. The neighborhood includes tennis and pickleball, miles of walking trails, a boathouse with paddle board/canoe rental on Western Lake, a lazy river, and multiple community pools. Next to a nature reserve, our home sits on the end of a very quiet street. In the wooded yard, a pergola, with a Green Egg grill and patio seating, is great for relaxing and dining. The back deck has a picnic table, the front porch includes ample seating and a large porch swing. Inside, the luxurious open dining-kitchen area has a serene, calming effect, a great space for all to hang out and unwind. The kitchen features high-end appliances with bar seating for 4, the dining table seats 6. The first-floor primary suite, king, features a sitting room, dual shower, dual vanity and a private, screened balcony.

Upstairs, a second primary bedroom, king, is down the hall from a cute bunk room, with a twin over full-futon bunk, and another twin. Each bedroom has its own bathroom. Parking fits 1 large and 1 smaller vehicle, and a Tesla home charger. The four bikes are complimentary, making daily visits to the beach and the pools, easy and fun. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. 109 Sandy Creek Dr is convenient to amazing attractions in WaterColor and Seaside: - 7 min bike ride or 20 min walk to WaterColor Beach Club and beach - 7 min bike ride or 20 min walk to Seaside - 5 min walk to Camp WaterColor pool, lazy river and snack bar - 5 min walk to the serene Frog Pool - 3 min bike ride or 14 min walk to the Boathouse on Western Lake for paddleboard rentals and fishing Overview: - 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths - 2,315 sq ft - 7 min bike ride or 20 min walk to WaterColor Beach Club and beach (private access) - Access to WaterColor community pools, tennis courts, boathouse and trails - Outdoor deck and patio with green egg and propane grill - Wi-Fi - 4 bikes included - Tesla home charger at the house - Limited onsite parking, minimal community parking w/pass Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; private bath with dual shower - 1st floor hall half bath - King in 2nd floor primary; private full bath - Twin over full bunk and single twin in 2nd floor 3rd bedroom; private full bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
